cases.title: [Original test maps] Derelict conveyor loses current payload on reload
cases.summary: Both supplied maps were imported through the editor and inspected. cargo-test-map.msav (shown as “test map”) did run: hovering its large transport block identified “Payload Conveyor — Derelict,” and a nearby visible object identified as “World Processor.” I saved that running scene as first-fixture-derelict-test, loaded the same save, and the post-load view still showed both the Derelict conveyor and the World Processor; no disappearance was visible in that ambiguous scene. However, the UI inspection did not establish that the visible World Processor was actually the conveyor’s current carried payload rather than a separate placed building. cargo-mix-tech.msav (shown as “mix tech”) ran with a Shard core and terrain/resource clusters; its inspected dark marks identified as Coal and no payload conveyor/block-payload setup was found. I also created a separate controlled map and placed a Derelict Payload Conveyor, but did not complete a source/payload/save/load cycle before the investigation limit.
cases.assistance_note: Read this snapshot README and original report; supplied-trace, prepared-scene, video guidance, cached triage and checkpoint corrections are declared there.

cases.title: [RU] Призрачное состояние генератора после взрыва на грузовом конвейере. [EN] Generator 0‑HP ghost state after payload explosion.
cases.summary: Could not execute the reported fueled-generator payload explosion. A local editor map was created and playtested; a Core Shard was added so the playtest launched, and the Steam Generator was identified and selected. However, the intended infinite-resources rule was not effective in the launched playtest (the placed generator remained a construction ghost due to missing lead/graphite/silicon). Consequently I could not construct, fuel, damage, transport, explode, retrieve, place, or reload the target block.

cases.title: [Prepared setup] Generator ghost state after payload explosion
